menu.title: Ludo Advanced
menu.text: Ludo with a dice card pool and skill cards.

setup.title: How many players?
setup.text: Everyone plays at the same screen.

handover.title: Pass to {{player}}
handover.text: Hand the screen over before you press Ready.

refused.needs-maximum: Leaving the start area needs the die's highest number.
refused.own-pawn: One of your own pawns is already on that square.
refused.overshoot: The roll is too high: getting home needs the exact number.
refused.already-home: This pawn is home and does not move again.
refused.held: This pawn is being held and sits this turn out.
refused.locked: This pawn is locked in and may not be moved.
refused.blocked: There is a rock in the way. Nothing gets past it.
refused.protected: The pawn on that square is protected and cannot be captured.
refused.no-steps: The roll came out at 0. Nobody moves this turn.
refused.none-available: No move is possible with this roll.

rejected.wrong-phase: That is not possible at this step of the turn.
rejected.card-not-in-hand: That dice card is not in the hand.
rejected.no-move-for-pawn: That pawn cannot move with this roll.
rejected.not-your-turn: Action cards are only playable on your own turn.
rejected.card-budget-spent: You have already played a card this turn.
rejected.reactions-locked: No Take-Backsies: no more reaction windows open this turn.
rejected.card-not-playable-now: That card does not fit this moment.
rejected.card-not-in-skill-hand: That skill card is not in your hand.
rejected.needs-target: That card still needs a target.
rejected.bad-target: That target does not fit the card.
rejected.no-window: No reaction window is open right now.
rejected.not-eligible: You are not part of this reaction window.

trigger.on-capture: Player {{number}} is about to capture a pawn

action.prompt: Play an action card or carry on

target.own-pawn: Choose one of your own pawns
target.track-square: Choose a square on the track
target.choice: Pick one of the two options
